note: Code 「メヘ一タ」: column メ (129-40E to 130-00E, good); row ヘ not in the okinawa-1945 key, so not plotted. 「敵ノ隊形ハ輪型陣ナリ 針路一七〇度 速力二四節」 (ring formation, course 170°, 24 kt), time 0845 on the intelligence message; the search plane's own line (T11 1段索 1/3Y, 「空母ヲ含ム敵部隊見ユ 空母×4 地點「メヘ一タ」 進行方向南 其ノ他十數隻」) has no time on this page. Read 28 Oct 2026 at 300 dpi

label: サキ四セ: carriers (second-stage search)
source: Recon 11 (801st Air Group) action report, pp. 13-14 (二段索敵 一番機, タナ二發信); 252nd message log p. 08
note: 20' grid square, decoded with kit/tools/jgrid.py (okinawa-1945 key: column サ good, row キ good); subdivision 四セ not decoded. A square, not a fix. 1130 is the plane's report (空母ヲ含ム敵部隊發見); the 252nd's log (p08) has 「敵空母二隻見ユ 地點「サキ四セ」」 and the 1154 order sends the Kokubu Suisei at the carriers there as of 1137. The square's centre is about 40 nm NE of Haynsworth's 1200 fix

label: スフ二イ: 4 carriers (second-stage search)
source: 252nd Air Group action report, message log p. 09 (T11 2段索)
note: 「敵空母×4見ユ 地點「スフ二イ」」 1310, read 28 Oct 2026 at 400 dpi; フ is clear. Column ス (129-20E to 129-40E, probable); row フ not in the okinawa-1945 key, so not plotted. The same plane's next line, 1326, 「敵空母×2見ユ 地點「?一サ」」, has a three-character code whose first character (ホ or 示) is unclear: not entered. See jgrid anchor O10

note: 「空母四隻ヨリ成ル敵KDB發見」 at 「マキ三シ」, 1505. Row キ (27-20N to 27-40N, good); column マ not in the okinawa-1945 key, so not plotted. Read 27 Oct 2026 (o-r11-1130)

label: メツ四セ: 4 carriers (third-stage search)
source: 252nd Air Group action report, message log p. 09 (T11 3段 1索)
note: 「空母×4見ユ 地點「メツ四セ」」 1507, read 28 Oct 2026 at 400 dpi. 20' grid square (okinawa-1945 key: column メ good, row ツ good); subdivision 四セ not decoded. A square, not a fix. The same square as the 0800 メツ三ス. Haynsworth's track between her 1200 and 2000 fixes (26-55N 129-31E to 27-23N 130-05E) passes through it; interpolated, she would be near 27-05N 129-44E at 1500 (derived, a lead only)

label: Izumi fighters sight a force: 徳之島ノ南方二十浬
source: Tsukuba and Yatabe air groups (Izumi), action report p. 03 (自隊ノ戦斗経過, 四月六日)
note: 「徳之島ノ南方二十浬ニテ上空直衛F6F八機ヲ有スル機動部隊（特空母一 巡洋艦二 駆逐艦四）南進中ナルヲ発見」: a force of one escort carrier, two cruisers and four destroyers heading south, eight F6F overhead; not engaged. No time for the sighting (the thirteen Zeros took off at 0900). South taken as 180°; the reference point on the island is approximate. Read 28 Oct 2026 (o-izumi-0406)
